cd /app && python3 << 'EOF'
import cv2
import numpy as np

cap = cv2.VideoCapture('example_video.mp4')
i = 0
prev = None
while True:
    ret, frame = cap.read()
    if not ret: break
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    if prev is not None:
        diff = cv2.absdiff(gray, prev)
        mask = (diff > 30).astype(np.uint8)
        n = mask.sum()
        if n > 0:
            ys, xs = np.nonzero(mask)
            print(f'frame {i}: diff_px={n} bbox x=[{xs.min()},{xs.max()}] y=[{ys.min()},{ys.max()}]')
        else:
            print(f'frame {i}: diff_px=0')
    prev = gray
    i += 1
print('total frames:', i)
EOF
